businesses.business: patient monitoring and noninvasive medical technology

offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures noninvasive patient monitoring technologies, including pulse oximetry, brain function and hemodynamic monitors, and connected sensors. Sells to hospitals, clinicians and emergency medical services, and to consumers through wearable and connected devices. Products are made in-house and sold with recurring disposable sensors.

primary_products.value: pulse oximeters; patient monitors; disposable and reusable sensors; brain function monitors; telehealth and connectivity systems

primary_services.value: monitoring software and connectivity services; technical support and training

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, clinicians, emergency medical services, OEM monitor makers, home care providers; B2C: consumers buying wearable health devices and home monitors; B2G: government and military healthcare facilities

end_markets.value: hospital care; emergency medicine; home healthcare; consumer health

revenue_model.value: product sales: monitors, instruments and recurring disposable sensors; licensing or royalties: technology licensing and royalties from OEM partners; service fees: software, connectivity and support services
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds monitoring devices and sensors from purchased components, sold to hospitals and OEMs; brand owner: markets branded consumer health devices to individuals

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: pulse oximetry, patient monitoring, sensors, brain monitoring and connectivity software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force selling to hospitals and health systems; distributors / dealers: international and regional medical distributors; partners / resellers: OEM partners embedding its technology in their monitors; online: consumer devices sold online
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance and CE marking, quality system and foreign regulators

notes: Consumer audio business was sold, so it is excluded; the current portfolio details may have changed.
